hypotheses.K0_full_recurrence_is_exact: The all-block recurrence matches direct gradients at every site with cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02.
hypotheses.K1_source_eight_replication: Blocks 2 through 9 reach median gradient cosine at least 0.90 and 10th percentile at least 0.75.
hypotheses.K2_source_eight_causal_replication: Their top-64 coalitions increase semantic score on at least 95% of finite patches and recover at least 80% of exact mean shift.
hypotheses.K3_early_attention_beats_late_attention: The source-near eight-block window beats the logit-near window by at least 0.10 median cosine and 0.10 exact-normalized mean finite shift.
hypotheses.K4_no_single_attention_block_is_sufficie: Every single-block program has median gradient cosine below 0.80.
hypotheses.K5_no_single_attention_block_is_decisive: Every leave-one-block-out program retains median gradient cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.K6_source_eight_transfers_across_feature: Every feature has median gradient cosine at least 0.80 and finite directional fraction at least 0.75.
hypotheses.K7_source_four_is_insufficient_control: Blocks 2 through 5 have median gradient cosine below 0.90 or recover less than 80% of exact mean finite shift.
